description: This file defines the Announcement model class for the Goteo software project. It manages announcement data including types, validation, retrieval, and persistence, and includes methods related to announcement attributes and behaviors.

classes.name: Announcement
classes.description: Model class representing an announcement with properties such as title, description, type, dates, and related project, providing methods for validation, persistence, and type-specific checks.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of announcements with optional filtering, pagination, and language specification.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns an array of property names that are language-specific (translatable) fields.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the announcement data, checking for required fields like title and description.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the announcement object to the database, handling insert or update operations.

methods.name: hasCTA
methods.description: Checks if the announcement has a call-to-action URL and text set.

methods.name: isAProjectAnnouncement
methods.description: Determines if the announcement is related to a project.

methods.name: isAGeneralAnnouncement
methods.description: Checks if the announcement is of general type.

methods.name: isADonationAnnouncement
methods.description: Checks if the announcement is of donation type.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of all valid announcement types.
